## CPU numerical route: inspect the selector before setup

Practice setup defaults `ARENA_DIFFUSION_NUMERICAL_ONLY` to `"1"` when the environment has no explicit override, and sets `RUN_OPTIONAL_NATIVE=False`. This gives `NUMERICAL_ONLY=True`, `RUN_COPY_WARMUP=False`, `RUN_TEXT_STUDY=False`, and `device=cpu`. Check these values before continuing. If you previously exported the selector as`"0"`, reset it to`"1"` before setup in a fresh kernel. The numerical route keeps schedule/noising/loss/sampler, finite reverse-kernel, entropy/commitment, attention/cache and scoring tests available without downloading a model or corpus. The immediate tiny training-loop correctness test still performs a small supplied CPU training fixture; the large copy and text-study experiments remain off.

Prerequisites are Original ARENA1.1 attention, cross entropy and KV caching; later corpus/tokenizer recipes are not prerequisites for the first finite-probability exercises. Keep the copy/text flags off for this route. The final archived-native proof reader is guarded by `RUN_OPTIONAL_NATIVE` in Practice, so absent optional native artifacts do not interrupt the numerical exercises. The unmodified Reference notebook retains historical code and outputs and does not itself default to this guarded route.

To keep new exploratory artifacts outside saved course evidence, optionally set before setup:

```python
import os
os.environ["ARENA_DIFFUSION_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY"] = "/tmp/arena_diffusion_numerical_working"
```

For the full copy/text experiment use a separate fresh kernel, deliberately set `ARENA_DIFFUSION_NUMERICAL_ONLY="0"`, and meet the documented CUDA, corpus/tokenizer and training budgets first. `RUN_OPTIONAL_NATIVE` separately enables the archived native-proof reader. Saved trajectories are historical outputs; numerical exercise success does not regenerate them.
